attr.title: GoldenEye 007 Beta
attr.desc: Beta native AArch64/GLES GoldenEye 007 source port for R36S with the ARM-GE Glass Control Deck. Player package only: benchmark, probing and port-debug instrumentation are excluded.
attr.inst: Install ge007.zip normally with PortMaster, provide your own verified US NTSC ROM at ge007/data/ge007.ntsc-final.z64, then launch GoldenEye 007 from Ports.
